item.title: Murph can change things in MCP servers, with your OK
item.summary: You can now turn on MCP server actions that change things. Before using one, Murph sends you a link that shows exactly what it will send, and nothing happens until you tap Do it and confirm with your Murph passkey.
item.details: Each change you confirm is sent once. If the MCP server's answer doesn't come back clearly, Murph tells you it may or may not have happened instead of trying again. A request you don't answer expires after an hour, and actions that only look things up work as before. Setting up your first Murph passkey now needs a sign-in with your phone or Telegram, not an email code.
